name: EPIC 220470763
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 5.8 solar radii and 1.14 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220470763 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 5.771459 (16th-84th percentiles 5.600316-5.951727), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,043 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 1.14 solar masses and 5.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,796 K at its surface.
